content.rendered:
Man can not exist on his own especially because life is more spiritual than physical. Everything that has ever come to being is made first in the spiritual than the physical. We are spiritual beings, therefore we are designed to have a daily connect with the spirit realm. No matter where and what we are, there’s always a spiritual void that can only be filled by God.

Today as you make the decision, you are welcome to a daily walk with the Father today as we take the walk step by step, precept upon precept

Prayer point: Lord I need you today much more than yesterday, fill me up and bring me to the full knowledge of you in Jesus name
